steps.en: Install the browser extension from the Chrome Web Store
steps.zh: 从 Chrome 商店安装扩展
跑一次性的初始化向导

steps.en: Installs the global server, starts it, configures your coding agent
steps.zh: 装好全局服务、后台启动、顺手配好你的编码 agent

steps.en: Open a localhost page, click Annotate, mark what's wrong
steps.zh: 打开 localhost 页面，点 Annotate，标出不满意处

steps.en: Stores annotations per project and page, serving extension and agent alike
steps.zh: 批注按项目和页面归档，同时供扩展和 agent 读

steps.en: Let the agent implement via MCP — or View all, Copy, paste
steps.zh: 让 agent 经 MCP 直接实现——或 View all、Copy、粘贴

steps.en: The fix loop closes without anyone touching app code
steps.zh: 修复闭环就此合上，全程没人改过应用代码

value.en: Whoever sees the UI problem can feed it straight to the coding agent — no repo access, no install steps, no clipboard archaeology.
value.zh: 谁看见 UI 问题谁就能直接喂给编码 agent——不用仓库权限、不用装依赖、不用翻剪贴板考古。
